conv.rule: abs(candidate - fp64) <= max(absolute_floor, absolute_term_mass * S) + relative * abs(fp64)
conv.S: fp64 sum of absolute terms contributing to the same entry
conv.rationale: DESIGN.public.md section 6, accommodates fixed fp32 dot and tile merge order at real lengths

finite_difference.rule: Each centered result and h/h2/2h disagreement satisfy absolute + relative * abs(projected gradient).
